newsitem.title: UK: Sedgwick says surprised by UK pensions move.
newsitem.headline: Sedgwick says surprised by UK pensions move.

text.p: British insurance company Sedgwick Group Plc on Tuesday expressed surprise at being singled-out for criticism by Treasury minister Helen Liddell over its response to her call for action over industry pensions mis-selling.

"It is a surprise that Sedgwick was named this afternoon in a statement made by Mrs Liddell. We remain committed to completing the review within the timetable already agreed with our regulators," it said in a statement.
The company said Liddell appeared to have taken exception to a comment in a covering letter to a report it had submitted on its strategy for speeding up the review of pension cases.
But is also welcomed the government's "determination to speed up the completion of all outstanding pensions reviews throughout the industry".
Last month Liddell said progress by 24 pensions companies would be reviewed each month and information published about the progress made by each firm.
On Tuesday she also said she was not satisfied with the response by Legal and General Group Plc.
